channel.title: Black Panther Store - Science Shirts
channel.description: Daily featured design for Science Shirts

item.title: Stop your Grinnin T-Shirt
item.description: “Stop your grinnin’ and drop your linen”, was one of twenty famous slogans in the second installment 1986 science, fiction, action movie called Aliens. Sigourney Weaver played in the lead role and had to combat aliens on the moon. One of the colonial marines that accompanied her to the moon, Bill Paxton, who played private Hudson in the movie, mentioned the slogan just before they had to disembark their dropship and go on a search and destroy mission. I changed the slogan slightly to “Stop your grinnin and drop your linnin.

item.title: No Footprints Required - Math Equations Bigfoot T-Shirt
item.description: Who needs physical footprints when you have mathematical proof? This glowing green wireframe Bigfoot was plotted using Fourier Transform epicycles on a custom-built drawing application. A great design for programmers, physicists, and mathematicians who prefer precise equations over field research.

item.title: Fourier Transform Spinosaurus - Math Dinosaur T-Shirt
item.description: This design was created using a custom-coded application programmed to trace the Spinosaurus outline using Fourier transform math. Rather than a standard text-to-image AI generation, this piece features authentic mathematical plotting, with the body details filled in using the actual FFT equations from the process.

item.title: Decomposing The Myth - Fourier Analysis Bigfoot T-Shirt

item.title: Bigfoot Drawn with Math: Fourier Transform Red Glow T-Shirt
item.description: A glowing neon red Bigfoot design that is 100% drawn and traced using mathematical equations, specifically Fourier Transform math formulas that plot the lines to create the artwork. The vibrant red nodes and epicycles visualize the complex mathematics used to draw Sasquatch. Perfect for math teachers, physics students, programmers, and anyone who loves geeky, science-themed apparel with a striking red hot laser aesthetic.
